GENERATE BURST L9-forest-0_0-fix — Run C-9 P5 parallax repair (conductor-found keying defect in L9-forest-0_0-r1). task_id "L9-forest-0_0-fix".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1, one panel of a painted forest parallax layer. ABOVE the line of treetops, part of the image is BLACK or a dark gradient; that whole area must be flat uniform pure #00ff00 (the sky layer shows through there in the game). Change ONLY that: every pixel above the treetop silhouette becomes flat pure #00ff00, with a clean edge along the treetops. Keep the trees, river, meadows and every painted pixel below the treetops EXACTLY as they are; do not repaint, restyle or move anything. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 1.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if any area above the treetops is not flat pure #00ff00 or the painted forest changed — name the reason. Copy the output to out/L9-forest-0_0.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L9-forest-0_0-fix"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (fix only the area above the treetops)
